scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev" "pnpm --filter ml dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter backend lint && pnpm --filter frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter backend typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck
